prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity MOBILE WEB SHOPPING UI composition, one flat screenshot with aspect ratio 1:2 (1024x2048, representing 390x780 CSS viewport). Do NOT copy its admin content, forms, merchant dashboard or card hierarchy. Restrained light Operate mode, real legible Traditional Chinese UI, clear 16px-ish body text and minimum 44px tap targets. One main action, not repeated CTAs. No photography: the implemented catalog has no image field. Subject must appear via actual product title, description, SKU and amount. No invented star ratings, sales, stock quantities, discounts, logo, testimonials, customer photos, badges, shipping provider logos, certification, payment confirmation, chat input or fake stock availability. Do not introduce gradients, shadows, large pills, decorative icon cards, promotional hero banners or huge empty space. Preserve one coherent navy/teal flat control family. Render full polished layout to the bottom of viewport; exact text must remain readable. STRUCTURE C — THREE-STEP GUIDED PURCHASE, FIRST STEP ACTIVE. Store header and demo notice. Page heading '開始購買'. A compact single summary row containing product title, price and short description without a photo. Under it, three accessible progress stations in one horizontal row: 1 '商品' active teal circle, 2 '配送' outlined, 3 '確認付款' outlined; only step1 active, no success ticks. Main content below titled '規格與數量', vertical SKU radio rows NAVY-01 selected and SAND-01, then a quantity row with minus/1/plus. Thin divider then subtotal and delivery note. One full-width teal button '下一步：配送' near bottom; no fake Pay button yet, no permanently repeated CTA or long form. Product summary stays shorter than main active-step controls; clear hierarchy and comfortable thumb reach.
